# Test fixture provenance

All files in this directory are repository-owned test data.

- `media/synthetic-tone.wav` is a deterministic, one-second 440 Hz mono tone generated by `generate_synthetic_media.py`. It is synthetic, contains no speech or copyrighted program content, and is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
- `providers/*.json` are hand-authored mocked provider payloads. They contain invented text and identifiers only.
- The fixtures contain no real credential, API key, personal data, or source-program excerpt.

這些測試資料完全由本專案產生或手工撰寫，不含原始影片內容、真實個資、真實金鑰或付費 API 回應。
